spec.expr:
(
  100 *
  (
    sum(increase(s3_upload_success_total[1h])) or vector(0)
  )
  /
  clamp_min(
    (
      (sum(increase(s3_upload_success_total[1h])) or vector(0))
      +
      (sum(increase(s3_upload_failure_total[1h])) or vector(0))
    ),
    1
  )
)

spec.title: Retry Activity
spec.subtitle: How aggressively recovery logic is working.

spec.expr:
100 *
(
  sum(rate(s3_upload_success_total[5m]))
)
/
clamp_min(
  (
    sum(rate(s3_upload_success_total[5m]))
    +
    sum(rate(s3_upload_failure_total[5m])) or vector(0)
  ),
  1
)

spec.title: Uploads vs Recordings
spec.description:
Healthy - Lines overlap
Broken - Generation > Upload

spec.expr:
sum by (station)(
  rate(upload_duration_seconds_sum[5m])
)
/
sum by (station)(
  rate(upload_duration_seconds_count[5m])
)
